data_policy.rights_note: Source images remain owned by their respective rights holders. Downloading and public visibility do not establish a redistribution license. No full descriptions, videos, game code or other game assets stored.

scope.sampling_rule: First ten game cards in current rendered section order; exclude non-game creation promotion; first five unique game details across sampled sections.
scope.section_definition_raw: 过去 24 小时内玩家数量增幅最大
scope.position_semantics: Observed carousel game-card order, not an independently verified official rank

limitations: Public discovery cards only; no account information, avatars, private lists or recently played history stored.
Displayed plays and likes have unspecified accumulation windows; abbreviated K/M counts are approximate.
No numerical player growth is displayed. Trending definition does not convert plays into growth.
Section order is not guaranteed descending by displayed plays; no inferred ranking formula.
Image HTTP status and headers are not exposed by the supported browser download API.
